report:
1. Noor II is expected to supply 0.6 TWh of electricity per year. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ouarzazate_Solar_Power_Station)
2. Noor II is a 220 MW concentrated solar plant using parabolic troughs. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ouarzazate_Solar_Power_Station)
3. Serogroup A meningitis cases in the African belt fell by more than 50% between 2010 and 2015. [WHO](https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/meningitis-belt-statistics-2031)
4. Oak Ridge plans to replace Frontier with a successor system named Discovery in 2028. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frontier_(supercomputer))
5. Morocco's bet on concentrated solar power was a visionary move that every African country should copy. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ouarzazate_Solar_Power_Station)
6. Frontier occupies more than 100 rack cabinets. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frontier_(supercomputer))
7. Noor I, the first phase of Morocco's Ouarzazate solar complex, has 160 MW of installed capacity and was connected to the grid on 5 February 2016. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ouarzazate_Solar_Power_Station)
8. Béjaïa Province had 697,669 inhabitants at the 1998 census. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Algerian_provinces_by_population)
9. Tassili n'Ajjer was added to UNESCO's World Heritage list in 1982. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tassili_n%27Ajjer)
10. Oran Province had 1,584,607 inhabitants at the 1998 census. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Algerian_provinces_by_population)
11. At 118 m high and with a capacity of 960 million m³, the Beni Haroun dam in Mila province is Algeria's largest dam. [Wikipédia](https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barrage_de_Beni_Haroun)
12. Algiers Province had roughly 2.99 million inhabitants at the 2008 census. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Algerian_provinces_by_population)
13. Frontier is the most impressive feat of engineering of the past decade. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frontier_(supercomputer))
14. Tassili n'Ajjer covers an area of about 82,000 km². [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tassili_n%27Ajjer)
15. Tassili n'Ajjer National Park receives around 3,000 foreign visitors a year. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tassili_n%27Ajjer)
16. The Beni Haroun dam has a raw-water pumping station with a capacity of 280 MW. [Wikipédia](https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barrage_de_Beni_Haroun)
17. Algeria's real GDP grew 3.7% in 2024. [World Bank](https://www.worldbank.org)
18. Oak Ridge built Frontier together with HPE Cray and AMD at a cost of US$600 million. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frontier_(supercomputer))
19. Ethiopia has an estimated hydropower potential of about 45 GW.
20. Algiers Province has the highest population density of any Algerian province. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Algerian_provinces_by_population)
